mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adhoc_server_instance (instance_id, host, http_port, grpc_port, status, accepting, start_time, version, heartbeat_time) VALUES (#{instanceId},#{host},#{httpPort},#{grpcPort},'UP',1,NOW(),#{version},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status='UP', accepting=1, start_time=NOW(), heartbeat_time=NOW(), version=VALUES(version), grpc_port=VALUES(grpc_port)
mapper.update: UPDATE adhoc_server_instance SET heartbeat_time=NOW(), status='UP', cpu_usage_pct=#{metrics.cpuUsagePct}, system_cpu_usage_pct=#{metrics.systemCpuUsagePct}, memory_usage_pct=#{metrics.memoryUsagePct}, memory_used_mb=#{metrics.memoryUsedMb}, memory_max_mb=#{metrics.memoryMaxMb}, heap_committed_mb=#{metrics.heapCommittedMb}, non_heap_used_mb=#{metrics.nonHeapUsedMb}, non_heap_committed_mb=#{metrics.nonHeapCommittedMb}, thread_count=#{metrics.threadCount}, daemon_thread_count=#{metrics.daemonThreadCount}, gc_count=#{metrics.gcCount}, gc_time_ms=#{metrics.gcTimeMs}, gc_time_ratio_pct=#{metrics.gcTimeRatioPct}, loaded_class_count=#{metrics.loadedClassCount}, uptime_ms=#{metrics.uptimeMs}, load_score=#{metrics.loadScore} WHERE instance_id=#{instanceId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM adhoc_server_instance WHERE status='UP' ORDER BY heartbeat_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE adhoc_server_instance SET status='DOWN' WHERE status='UP' AND heartbeat_time < NOW() - INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND
UPDATE adhoc_server_instance SET accepting=0 WHERE instance_id=#{instanceId}
